services.desc: Explore the Bay! 90 minutes About Do you want to experience the wonders of the San Francisco Bay up close? Set your sights on the Bay Voyager 90 minute excursion, and venture down the waterfront to world famous Pier 39 in our unique vessel! We will outfit you with foul weather gear (to keep you warm and dry from the occasional splash), and then you will board our 12 passenger vessel to explore under the Golden Gate and Bay Bridges, and along the cityfront and then head back to our homeport for a quick visit to the world famous Pier 39 Sea Lions! No need for binoculars on this trip, 90 minutes • Ages 5+

includes: We are excited for your adventure and have included some very important information below so please take a minute to read below.
blurb: Guests take high-speed boat tours around San Francisco Bay, seeing landmarks like the Golden Gate Bridge, Fort Point, and sea lions at Pier 39. Tours include narration by licensed captains and photo stops. Private charters and customized routes are available.
